Name: Shuah the Canaanite
Summary: Shuah was a Canaanite whose daughter married Judah, and whose grandsons were Er, Onan, and Shelah.
KeyStory: Judah married Shuah's daughter in Canaan, and her sons' story became part of the line leading to David.
RelatedPeople: Judah; Er; Onan; Shelah, Son of Judah
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
